sections.title: Identity and habitat
sections.text: The catalogue's Cardamine entry is Cardamine pratensis, cuckoo flower, rather than the genus as a whole. This perennial of wet meadows is about 20–50 cm tall, with a pinnate basal rosette, pale four-petalled flowers 1–2 cm across and narrow siliques about 2.5–4 cm long.

sections.title: Food and image
sections.text: Kew records leaves and flowers as food. The plate's pinnate rosette, pale four-petalled flowers and narrow pods match the species.
